versions.changelog: Works on every Jellyfin 12.x (was 12.4 only); listed under Music

name: Tunefin
description: Search and play YouTube Music in Jellyfin and Finamp with your own YouTube account. Liked songs are downloaded into a private per-user library, and your YouTube Music likes can be imported. Needs the ytm-sidecar service.
overview: YouTube Music search, playback and liked-song downloads
